Mobile_same_image_comparison: Same-image mobile validation comparison. Columns show the original image, reference annotations, controlled baseline, RT-DETR-L, and DENT-STRIDE; each enlarged row uses an identical target region across columns. Teal boxes denote reference annotations and orange boxes denote model predictions. Saved seed-0 model outputs use score ≥0.30 and clinical FDI decoding; FDI text labels identify the highlighted target’s localization match, while other retained predictions remain visible as boxes. (A) Image 111: the highlighted reference tooth is FDI 51; the controlled baseline wrong assignment (11) and full-model correct assignment (51) accompany image-level correct-match counts of 4 and 7. (B) Image 56: the highlighted reference tooth is FDI 62; the controlled baseline correct assignment (62) and full-model wrong assignment (52) accompany image-level correct-match counts of 5 and 2. Examples include an improvement and a deterioration and do not estimate their population frequencies. The external detector retains its framework-specific training and post-processing.

Mobile_inter_module_comparison: Mobile inter-module comparison using independently trained controlled seed-0 models at the same resolution and operating threshold. Columns show the original image, reference annotations, baseline, features only, identity only, and complete configuration; each case pairs the whole image with an identical local enlargement. Features comprise CMFA and HOOA; identity comprises factorized supervision/fusion and prototype auxiliary supervision. FDI text labels identify the highlighted target’s localization match, while other retained predictions remain visible as boxes. Panel A uses image 111 and panel B image 56. Complete validation results, rather than these selected examples, establish each configuration’s measured performance.
Pano_same_checkpoint_prior_comparison: Same-checkpoint DENTEX anatomical-prior replay. Each column starts from the same 300 pre-top-k query boxes and logits; only the training-derived center/shape score terms change before native top-k selection. Rows compare reference annotations with no prior, center only, shape only, and combined scoring using score ≥0.30; all local enlargements share the same region. (A) Image 66: combined scoring suppresses incorrect/repeated candidates, reducing false-positive predictions from 9 to 6 while retaining 27 correct matches; the highlighted FDI 12 tooth is retained and an additional FDI 13 candidate falls below the display threshold. This is score-based candidate suppression, not a corrected highest-class identity. (B) Image 214: the same highlighted query box changes its highest retained label from the correct FDI 27 to FDI 28; image-level correct matches decrease from 15 to 14. Bounding boxes are unchanged. These selected examples illustrate both favourable and adverse scoring effects.
Acquisition_cohort_montage: Representative images and reference FDI annotations from the three validation cohorts: (A) panoramic radiographs, (B) smartphone intraoral photographs, and (C) five-view DSLR photographs. Two images per cohort illustrate differences in field of view, framing, illumination, and appearance. Teal boxes mark reference tooth annotations. Visible gaps or occlusions are not interpreted as diagnoses of missing teeth.
